description.value:
A card linked to your biomonitor. Seriously Wounded, you may crush it as a free action; it crushes itself if you're knocked out Seriously Wounded or reach Mortally Wounded. Trauma Team arrives in 2d6 rounds (roll 1d12 too: REO may beat them to you).

  • Paramedics perform Surgery if you agree to pay for it.
  • Free cryotank recovery, or a hospital room at 100eb a night; bills due by the end of the month.
  • Standard and Addiction Therapy available at participating clinics (at their cost).
  • Reliable, no extortion, trained to extract you mid-firefight. The card can be hacked.

Needs a Good PrePak lifestyle or better; it's cancelled if you drop below. Bought mid-month, it starts on rent day.

Health plan: 500eb a month. Surgery not included.
